_comment: Smart Search external site profile for the Joomla Programmers Manual (Docusaurus). Its sitemap lists the older versions and the update notes but not the current version (unversioned /docs/), so /docs/ is also crawled through its links. Use with tools/add-site-task.php, or copy the params into a new 'Smart Search: index external site' task.
title: Smart Search: index manual.joomla.org

params.exclude:
// Older and upcoming versions: only the current one (unversioned /docs/) is indexed.
/docs/(next|\d+\.\d+)/
